content: Effective ES/DCB showcase repos: tiny domain, one traced command, GWT tests as the spine of the narrative, explicit contrast with the conventional approach (aggregate/CRUD) so the delta is legible, runnable without external infra, comments at the decision points, and a design note stating tradeoffs. Nimbus demo and es-wallet explicitly frame the repo as 'can explain every line' / 'every ES interview question has tested code behind it'.
